about: Synthetic junk clips for the scoring calibration test. Generated by scripts/make-junk-clips.mjs; not recordings. No speech clip yet.

clips.notes: 2 s uniform white noise, RMS about -25 dBFS.
clips.author: CameCallHero contributors

clips.notes: 3 s low-pass filtered noise with slow gusts, RMS about -17 dBFS. Imitation of wind, not a recording.
clips.author: CameCallHero contributors

clips.notes: Three 80 ms noise bursts with ~8 ms decay, 0.5 s apart. Imitation of claps, not a recording.
clips.author: CameCallHero contributors

clips.notes: 2 s steady pink noise (Kellet filter), RMS about -21 dBFS.
clips.author: CameCallHero contributors

clips.notes: 0.5 s quiet, then a 1.2 s exponential sine sweep 300 Hz to 3 kHz at 0.3 amplitude, 20 ms fades.
clips.author: CameCallHero contributors
